description: This PHP class 'Links' implements a part of a JSON API, specifically handling link relations such as self, pagination, related links, and associated metadata. It includes methods for setting various links and metadata, validating URLs, and outputting the links as a JSON API response object.

classes.name: Links
classes.description: Represents a collection of JSON API links, including self, pagination, related links, and metadata, with methods to set and serialize these links.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Static factory method to instantiate a new Links object.

methods.name: withSelf
methods.description: Sets the 'self' URL if valid, logs an error if invalid, returns a clone of the object.

methods.name: withPagination
methods.description: Flags the Link object to include pagination links, returns a clone.

methods.name: withFirst
methods.description: Sets the 'first' pagination URL if valid, flags pagination, logs error if invalid, returns clone.

methods.name: withPrev
methods.description: Sets the 'prev' pagination URL if valid, flags pagination, logs error if invalid, returns clone.

methods.name: withNext
methods.description: Sets the 'next' pagination URL if valid, flags pagination, logs error if invalid, returns clone.

methods.name: withLast
methods.description: Sets the 'last' pagination URL if valid, flags pagination, logs error if invalid, returns clone.

methods.name: withMeta
methods.description: Merges provided meta array into existing meta, returns clone.

methods.name: withHref
methods.description: Sets the 'href' link URL, returns clone.

methods.name: withRelated
methods.description: Sets the 'related' link URL, returns clone.

methods.name: toJsonApiResponse
methods.description: Serializes the Link object into an array suitable for JSON API response.

methods.name: hasPagination
methods.description: Checks if pagination has been flagged.

methods.name: validateUrl
methods.description: Validates that a URL string is properly formatted.

methods.name: setLogger
methods.description: Sets the logger instance for this object.

methods.name: getLogger
methods.description: Retrieves the logger instance, creating a default if needed.
